summary: Comprehensive backend testing of 'Journal de régulation' feature: RBAC, event logging via tick + manual controls, filtering, sorting, and regression. 24/24 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >2200 lines - split into routers/services modules (users, installations, regulation, admin, etc.) for maintainability.

POST /system/master-power uses `on: bool` as query parameter which is unusual and error-prone for clients (e.g. body vs query confusion); consider Pydantic body model for consistency with PUT /system.
reg-logs endpoint uses limit cap 1000 but returned rows use created_at exclusion + ts sort; index on ts (or (owner_email, ts)) would better match query pattern than (owner_email, created_at).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo installation 8dd6f7e4-9919-4c5b-8f0c-8c395a389896 owned by client@demo.fr. Restored control_mode=cloud and power/setpoint after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: reg-logs journal fully verified: RBAC (super_admin+moderator 200, client 403, no-token 401/403); events (snapshot from tick, mode, setpoint, power via master-power, control_mode, plus diagnostic fault when triggered); filters (owner_email, etype, installation_id); ts desc sorting; limit respected and capped at 1000; accounts aggregation returns client@demo.fr with count>0. Valid modes are 'chaud'/'froid'. master-power expects `on` as query param.
